narrative: Material PL1__M560A5BF exhibits variable demand (CV=0.424) with a statistically significant declining trend over the observation period. Lead times are moderately volatile (CV=0.393, mean 4.18 days), and lead-time variability accounts for 71.8% of total buffer uncertainty. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy is recommended with a storage-constrained order quantity of 7,064 units, safety stock of 1,267 units, and reorder point of 3,303 units, delivering a 64.5% reduction in total annual inventory costs while maintaining a 95% service level.
warnings: High demand volatility (CV=0.424) - advanced forecasting recommended
Declining demand trend detected (p=0.019) - policy requires quarterly review
Storage capacity binding: EOQ capped from 12,331 to 7,064 units (max_storage_units=8,331.37)

research_insights.selection_rationale: Near-continuous consumption (97.1% non-zero days) and moderate-to-high demand variability favour a continuous-review model over periodic review. The EOQ framework minimises total ordering and holding costs, with the MOQ constraint (2,312 units) non-binding since EOQ exceeds it substantially.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity is binding: the unconstrained EOQ of 12,331 units is capped to 7,064 units. This increases ordering frequency and annual ordering costs relative to the unconstrained optimum, but the policy remains cost-superior to the current SAP baseline. If demand recovers from its current declining trend, the cap will tighten further and may require a storage capacity review.
research_insights.escalation_flag: No MOQ-capacity infeasibility (MOQ 2,312 + SS 1,267 = 3,579 ≤ 8,331). Escalation status: MONITOR due to medium boundary risk from storage constraint and moderate lead-time variability.
